nodes.name: Queen Bee Cluster
nodes.description: Management / DNS cluster (the k0rdent management context). Runs the Bindy operator, the BIND9 operands, and the canonical DNSZone and ARecord resources.

nodes.name: Queen Kubernetes API
nodes.description: API server of the Queen Bee cluster. Holds the canonical bindy-system namespace that every Scout fans records into.

nodes.name: Bindy Operator
nodes.description: The operator running on the Queen Bee cluster; reconciles ARecord CRs into BIND9 and manages zones.

nodes.name: BIND9 Operands
nodes.description: BIND9 named + bindcar operand pods on the Queen Bee cluster that actually serve DNS.

nodes.name: ARecord CRs (bindy-system)
nodes.description: Canonical ARecord resources in the Queen Bee bindy-system namespace, fanned in from every child cluster and stamped with source-cluster and zone labels. A record written by a registered Scout ServiceAccount carries one of that account's cluster names and an allowed zone; a DNSZone takes a Scout record only when its zone label equals the zone's name (ADR-0025). A Scout writes one ARecord per cluster, zone and DNS name, not one per source: the bindy.firestoned.io/scout-contributors annotation holds every contributing source's addresses and TTL, spec.ipv4Addresses is their union and spec.ttl the lowest, and the record is deleted with its last contributor (ADR-0026).

nodes.name: Scout source registry (bindy-scout-sources ConfigMap)
nodes.description: Per-namespace ConfigMap on the Queen Bee cluster mapping each child cluster's Scout ServiceAccount to the cluster names (<sa>.clusters) and zones (<sa>.zones) it may publish. Written by bindy bootstrap mc --cluster-name --allowed-zones (ADR-0025).

nodes.name: bindy-scout-source-binding
nodes.description: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy denying an ARecord CREATE, UPDATE or DELETE by a registered Scout ServiceAccount unless the old and new objects carry managed-by=scout, a source-cluster from the account's registry entry and an allowed zone label. Unregistered principals are not affected (ADR-0025).

nodes.name: Child Cluster A
nodes.description: A workload cluster in the k0rdent fleet. Runs a Scout instance with its own independently revocable ServiceAccount credentials.

nodes.name: Bindy Scout A
nodes.description: Scout Deployment (image bindy, args=[scout]) on Child Cluster A. Watches local Ingress / LoadBalancer Service / HTTPRoute / TLSRoute / TCPRoute through the shared watch layer (one watch and cache per kind, ADR-0009) and derives DNS names. Publishes only zones in --allowed-zones and addresses in --allowed-ip-ranges when those are set (ADR-0025). Sources (of any kind or namespace) that resolve to the same zone and DNS name are merged into one record with the complete address set (ADR-0026).

nodes.name: Ingress / Gateway (A)
nodes.description: Ingress objects, LoadBalancer Services, HTTPRoutes and TLSRoutes on Child Cluster A that expose workloads and carry the hostnames Scout resolves.

nodes.name: Child Cluster B
nodes.description: A second workload cluster, demonstrating record fan-in from many child clusters into one Queen Bee namespace.

nodes.name: Bindy Scout B
nodes.description: Scout Deployment on Child Cluster B with its own ServiceAccount, --cluster-name, --allowed-zones, --allowed-ip-ranges and remote kubeconfig.

nodes.name: Ingress / Gateway (B)
nodes.description: Ingress / Gateway API objects on Child Cluster B that Scout B observes.
